# GTASIX — independent GTA VI guides

Site: https://www.gtasix.tech/

An unofficial Grand Theft Auto VI resource. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

## Primary answers
- GTA 6 Online release date: https://www.gtasix.tech/gta-6-online/ — no official GTA VI multiplayer launch date as of November 20, 2026; the initial game is single player.

## Editorial standards
Each guide has dated source links and verification status. We distinguish Rockstar/PlayStation announcements, press reports, community complaints, and speculation. Online dates, crossplay and PC release must not be stated as confirmed without an official announcement.
Official sources: https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/ ; https://support.rockstargames.com/VI

## Gameplay help
- [Mission and gameplay helper](https://www.gtasix.tech/gta-6-mission-help/): spoiler-controlled early mission hints, practical checklists and device-local saved plans.
- [No mission marker](https://www.gtasix.tech/guides/gta-6-no-mission-marker-what-to-do/): objective and navigation checks.
- [Vice City comparison](https://www.gtasix.tech/guides/gta-6-map-vs-vice-city/): original city, Leonida and honest map comparisons.
- [Driving tips](https://www.gtasix.tech/guides/gta-6-driving-tips-and-physics/): control paths and practical driving guidance.
